cohort: 186 pregnant women aged 20-45 years with uterine leiomyomas at a tertiary care center in Hyderabad.
finding: Uterine fibroids were associated with several pregnancy complications, including a higher rate of cesarean section (78.66% of term pregnancies), PPH (28.49%), blood transfusion (39.25%), miscarriage (6.45%), cord prolapse (24.3%), and other adverse outcomes.
